name: Bel-Air
description: The journey of a book smart teen whose life is forever transformed when he moves from the streets of west Philadelphia to live with his relatives in one of LA’s wealthiest suburbs.

videos.title: Dreams and Nightmares
videos.overview: A talented West Philly teenager is sent to live in Bel Air to avoid the dangers of his hometown.

videos.title: Keep Ya Head Up
videos.overview: Will finds he doesn’t fit in at his new school; the Banks family starts to adjust to life with Will.

videos.title: Yamacraw
videos.overview: Will attends Uncle Phil's Black fraternity event and finds his groove with his family and peers.

videos.title: Canvass
videos.overview: The Banks family rallies around Uncle Phil to ramp up his campaign. Will’s past starts to catch up to him, and he finds help in an unexpected place.

videos.title: PA to LA
videos.overview: When Will’s friend Tray visits, his loyalty to Philly is put to the test. The Banks family supports Hilary by hosting an influencer event.

videos.title: The Strength to Smile
videos.overview: The Banks family supports Lisa when they host an event in memory of her mother at the mansion. Will puts his feelings of mistrust aside and steps up to the plate for the Bankses and Lisa.

videos.title: Payback's a B*tch
videos.overview: Will and Carlton throw a house party at the Banks mansion. When Phil unexpectedly shows up at Viv's art event, their relationship is shaken by a lack of trust. Hilary stands up to Kylo after he posts a video of her without her consent.

videos.title: No One Wins When the Family Feuds
videos.overview: As the Banks family celebrates Will's birthday, his mom comes to visit, causing unexpected tension. The adults consider whether it's time to tell Will about his father.

videos.title: Can't Knock the Hustle
videos.overview: The Banks family goes to church. Will considers taking the opportunity to find his father, unknowingly driving a wedge between Phil and Geoffrey.

videos.title: Where To?
videos.overview: Will’s father shows up and tells the truth about where he’s been, exposing a long-buried secret.

videos.title: A Fresh Start
videos.overview: Will works on being fully independent from the Banks family after a fallout with his father, Lou as Ashley celebrates her 13th birthday.

videos.title: Speaking Truth
videos.overview: Will alienates himself from the Bel-Air basketball team and finds appealing opportunities in love and basketball with the help of some new South LA friends.

videos.title: Compromised
videos.overview: When Ashley's favorite teacher is fired, Will goes to great lengths to help her out and leaves Carlton in an uncomfortable position

videos.title: Don't Kill My Vibe
videos.overview: After the protest, Will is suspended from the Bel-Air basketball team and looks to join an AAU team with Phil’s permission. Carlton deals with the fallout from the protest.

videos.title: Excellence Is Everywhere
videos.overview: Will struggles on his new basketball team but is nominated for a leadership award at Bel-Air Academy, causing friction with Carlton.

videos.title: Let the Best Man Win
videos.overview: Phil hosts the Banks family reunion, and Carlton works hard to impress his dad. Meanwhile, Will considers accepting the Founder’s Award nomination.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: External dilemmas throw Carlton and Will off track and prevent them from fully preparing for the Founder’s Award.

videos.title: Pursuit of Happiness
videos.overview: Will discovers the truth about his teammate’s absence, making him question his future. Carlton spirals out of control.

videos.title: Just Like Old Times
videos.overview: Will confides in Phil about the shocking information he discovered regarding Doc and Zenith. Carlton struggles to keep up with all the lies he’s entangled himself in.

videos.title: Don't Look Back
videos.overview: The Banks family comes together for the announcement of the Founder's Award and Will embraces moving forward in an unexpected way.

videos.title: Baby, I'm Back
videos.overview: The Banks family host their annual Juneteenth festivities; Will thinks about his future.

videos.title: Pivot
videos.overview: Will and Carlton get jobs at the Beverly Hills Country Club and it's nothing like they expected.

videos.title: True Colors
videos.overview: Will and Carlton go to a downtown car event to promote "Blackccess"; Phil scopes out a new client.

videos.title: Out All Night
videos.overview: Will and Carlton feel the pressure of running "Blackcess"; everyone rallies around Hilary.

videos.title: Getting Personal
videos.overview: Viv and Phil celebrate their anniversary, but something seems off between them.

videos.title: Baggage
videos.overview: Will brings his parents, Vy and Lou, together to heal the past; Carlton sees a new side of Amira.

videos.title: Black Lotus
videos.overview: Viv and Phil spend some quality time together at a resort in Mexico; Will is stuck in a hard place between his family and chosen family.

videos.title: Gimme a Break
videos.overview: Will's secret participation gets revealed, putting him at odds with Carlton over what "Blackccess" truly means to each of them.

videos.title: Family Matters
videos.overview: Will, Carlton and Lisa try to heal after witnessing a friend's overdose; Hilary prepares for her wedding; Geoffrey reveals the truth to Frederick.

videos.title: Save the Best for Last
videos.overview: The Bankses and family support Hilary during her wedding day in Martha's Vineyard; Will and Carlton work with Drew on "Blackccess."

videos.title: The Maybes
videos.overview: Will and Carlton start their senior year at Bel-Air Academy, forcing them to begin considering their next steps post-graduation.

videos.title: Be a Kid
videos.overview: It's Homecoming week at Bel-Air Academy, and Will and Carlton do it their way; Phil is forced to rethink his relationship with Geoffrey after being put in a tough position.

videos.title: What Are You Doing for Thanksgiving?
videos.overview: Will and Carlton face the consequences for their past choices; the Banks family and friends come together to celebrate Thanksgiving.

videos.title: Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: Will returns to his dream of playing college basketball to help secure admittance; Phil must make a tough business decision.

videos.title: Gorilla Glue and Duct Tape
videos.overview: Phil prepares Will and Carlton for life outside the gates of Bel-Air; Viv attempts to keep a grasp on her compounding responsibilities.

videos.title: Your Crown is Waiting
videos.overview: Will and Carlton have epiphanies regarding their futures; Phil takes strong measures to protect his family.

videos.title: Soulmates
videos.overview: The senior lock-in tests Will and Carlton's romantic relationships; the Banks family rallies to support Viv.

videos.title: The Next Act
videos.overview: As senior year comes to an end, everyone in the Banks family faces big changes -- ones that bring new places and unexpected reunions.
